headline: GQG Partners trims holdings across multiple Adani group companies

headline: Jefferies retains Buy rating on Adani Green with Rs 1,695 target
summary: Global brokerage Jefferies has maintained a 'Buy' rating on Adani Green Energy with a target price of Rs 1,695, representing a 35% upside from its recent close of Rs 1,255. The brokerage attributes this potential to attractive valuations following a 22% correction from peak levels, alongside rising power demand, better utilisation at the Khavda renewable project, and battery storage expansion. Indian retail investors tracking the renewable energy sector should note these execution and demand drivers supporting the green energy stock.
